command: node benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/record-memory-recall-readiness.mjs --tree <git archive of b6f10295a2f698afc85332467192de28500bd146 with node_modules>

entry.runs: embedRecallQuery (recall-embedding-readiness.mjs) with scripted isReady / canWarmup / warmup / embed / onWarmupError and an AbortSignal; setTimeout/clearTimeout are wrapped only to record the armed delay and whether it was cleared

exclusions: none: case 47 (timeout fallback) is recorded here with virtual timers (the wait timer is recorded and fired by hand; no real time passes)

normalised.timer handles: only the armed delay and the cleared flag are kept
normalised.trace: each scenario has an ordered `trace`: {step} = an action of the recorder (clock step, abort, release of a gate it holds), {event} = what the product did (product call, timer armed/cleared) or what settled (warmup settled/rejected, recall call settled/rejected), in the order they happened

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay: embed_recall_query (mixdog-services memory/recall/readiness.rs), the core's embedRecallQuery: the product's recall reaches it through RecallEmbedder::query_vector (readiness.rs, wired as the recall's QueryEmbedder in memory/boot.rs MemoryStack), which waits for a cold model at most cold_embed_wait() (MIXDOG_RECALL_COLD_EMBED_WAIT_MS, 3 s) and falls back to lexical recall. The replay (memory/replays/recall_readiness.rs, one test per case and further shape) scripts the embedder as the recorder did, gives the call a CancellationToken carrying the recorded abort reason, observes the wait's timer (armed delay, cleared, fired) through a test-only seam, fires it by advancing the paused tokio clock by the recorded delay, and compares per scenario the result or rejection whole, the injected-error identity, the ordered calls, the ordered trace (recorder steps at their recorded places, product events, settles) and the timer summary
timezone: UTC (process.env.TZ set by lib/mc-record.mjs before any date formatting: local-time text in a recording is UTC)
